scientific_role: fresh real-system validation candidate for calibration-only selective Layer-B promotion

source_identity.title: SNAPSHOT USA 2019-2023: The first five years of data from a coordinated camera trap survey of the United States

selection_basis: five annual survey years permit temporal inner/outer validation
deployment metadata and biological sequence response are physically separate files
deployment file contains year, array, site, deployment start/end, survey nights, coordinates and response-independent habitat/development/feature metadata
paper reports multiple arrays surveyed all five years, allowing response-blind focal-array selection

allowed_information: public file names and file sizes
README prose shown directly on the public landing page
allowed_live_operations: one GET of the frozen Dryad landing/dataset metadata route selected before execution

prospective_focal_array_rule.eligible_array: same normalized Camera_Trap_Array represented in all five years 2019-2023 with at least 7 distinct normalized Site_Name values in each year and positive Survey_Nights only
ranking: maximize minimum annual distinct-site count across the five years
then maximize total Survey_Nights across all five years

selective_promotion_rule.promotion: use baseline_plus_layer_b only if its frozen inner-validation macro binary log loss is strictly lower than baseline_only; otherwise use baseline_only
selective_promotion_rule.after_selection: freeze selected arm; refit according to frozen calibration policy; score untouched 2023 outer heldout once

if_stop: terminal pre-response STOP; do not change the selected metadata route or retry policy within this attempt
